The present contempt application has been filed pleading willful disobedience of the order dated 19.4.2022 passed by this Court in Writ C No.9340 of 2022.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The order dated 1.2.2023 also provides that the applicant may seek proceedings for payment of additional compensation.
As the order dated 1.2.2023 decides on merit, the claim of the applicant regarding mutation in Form-11, the said order is subject to challenge before the appropriate forum and it is not a case to further proceedings under the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.
The application is dismissed and consigned to records.
The applicant, if aggrieved by the order dated 1.2.2023, may challenge before the appropriate forum.
